correctness.rationale: The nonstandard step that each odd Takasaki subquandle is a coset is reconstructed from products of right reflections and invertibility of two on the finite odd group. Complement intersection and join reduce exactly to the nontrivial cyclic quotient generator criterion. Lifting counts are phi([A:M]) times [M:K], and cyclic local sums telescope to the closed sigma formula. Direct closure and subgroup computations in verify.py independently corroborate the polynomials and boundary cases. The proof, not finite evidence, establishes every asserted size and group.

value.rationale: The literature motivates whether quandle subobject lattices are complemented, but an exact complement incidence and size invariant is not furnished by mere existence. The theorem provides a uniform classification/enumeration for all finite odd abelian Takasaki quandles, a sharp prime-support stability law on cyclic groups, and an explicit equal-order subgroup embedding distinction in a noncyclic example. These are structurally motivated full-family invariants; no broader applications are assumed.
